name: thimble-lean
description: thimble's lean kernel and shell: the `lean` command reads and queries any files, keeps the code, inputs and source rows behind every value, and saves objects as program + data + lineage; each object Claude saves is drawn under its reply with the verbs that fit it, opens in a detail view that keeps the chat going, and opens in the browser and back. Verbs are folders in verbs/. An observer reads each answer and the objects behind it once after the turn: it leaves notes for Claude, ranks each object's hint row, and, rarely, shows one line above the prompt when a decision of the person's is in view.

observer.title: Observer
observer.description: After each turn of work, a side agent reads the answer and the objects behind it: it leaves notes for Claude, picks the verbs under each object, and, rarely, shows a line above your prompt when a decision is in view.
